To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the polished seeds of SW rice were found to be superior to those of GB and PB cultivar in terms of total phenolic content, total flavonoids, antioxidant capacity, and radical scavengng potential.

the unpolished seeds of all three cultivars are superior to their polished counterparts, but the polished seeds of SW are the most potent among the three cultivars in terms the majority of tested parameters, thus highlighting the better dietary importance of SW over GB and PB.
the polished seeds of indica rice cultivars are a good source of carbohydrates, especially starch, and antioxidants, especially phenolics and flavanoids.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the comparative evaluation of antioxidant parameters and the level of carbohydrates in unpolished and the polished seeds of three indica rice cultivars.
the identification of a better edible rice variety, which can be recommended for consumption by the general population.
the evaluation and comparative study of carbohydrate and antioxidant content and potential in three edible indica rice seed cultivars.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that

the polished seeds of all the three cultivars are good sources of carbohydrate and antioxidants, but the extent of accumulation of the latter is higher in SW seeds, making it a more desirable cultivar.

the polished seeds of SW are better than the other two cultivar polished seeds, with respect to the carbohydrate content and antioxidative parameters, and thus can be recommended for the preparation of rice-based food products.
SW is the best among the three cultivars in terms both carbohydrate and antioxidant content, and hence, it is the most preferred cultivar for human consumption.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
SW polished seeds are the best source of carbohydrates and antioxidants in the three indica rice cultivars tested, whereas GB polished seeds have better NO scavenging ability.

the antioxidant potential of polished rice grains could be enhanced by increasing the amylose content, and that the antioxidant potential could be enhanced further by the addition of antioxidants such as phenolics and flavanoids, and by decreasing the LOX activity.

the unpolished or polished rice seeds could be used in the food industry as functional foods for the prevention of chronic diseases, such as cancer and cardiovascular disorders. © 2013 Springer Science+Business Media Dordrecht.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the unpolished or polished rice seeds of the cultivars GB and PB can be used as an alternative to SW in food formulations, as they are also good sources of carbohydrates and antioxidants.
the antioxidant capacity and carbohydrate content are not only cultivar specific but are also influenced by the degree of polishing.
, the polished seeds of the three indica rice cultivars are good sources of carbohydrates, antioxidants and radical scavengers and can be included as part of a healthy diet.
